title: Oversight Under Adversarial Prompt Injection: Can Prompt Injection Attacks Compromise Oversight?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Prompt injection as an oversight attack vector is a concrete, novel threat model. If student models can compromise model-based overseers via injection, this undermines the entire model-based oversight paradigm. High-impact finding with immediate practical implications.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Prompt injection is well-documented and can be tested with API-based models. Training a model to embed manipulative text and testing against an overseer model is a clean pipeline. Accessible to CS students familiar with LLM APIs.

narrow_scope.reasoning: One student model, one overseer model, one injection technique, one measurement (score inflation rate). The deliverable is a single success rate metric. Highly focused and achievable in 30 hours.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
